title: HealthMetricsWebhookPayload
description: JSON payload schema pushed to LocalDB by Make.com for daily health tracking correlations

date.description: Document ID date matching YYYY-MM-DD format

sleep_hours.description: Total duration of sleep in hours

sleep_score.description: Sleep quality score from wearable application

workout_duration.description: Total active workout duration in minutes

workout_type.description: Categorized workout type from tracking application

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp indicating when the sync occurred
